<jats:title>A<jats:sc>bstract</jats:sc>
          </jats:title>
          <jats:p>The <jats:italic>p</jats:italic>-adic AdS/CFT correspondence relates a CFT living on the p-adic numbers to a system living on the Bruhat-Tits tree. Modifying our earlier proposal [1] for a tensor network realization of <jats:italic>p</jats:italic>-adic AdS/CFT, we prove that the path integral of a <jats:italic>p</jats:italic>-adic CFT is equivalent to a tensor network on the Bruhat-Tits tree, in the sense that the tensor network reproduces all correlation functions of the <jats:italic>p</jats:italic>-adic CFT. Our rules give an explicit tensor network for any <jats:italic>p</jats:italic>-adic CFT (as axiomatized by Melzer), and can be applied not only to the <jats:italic>p</jats:italic>-adic plane, but also to compute any correlation functions on higher genus <jats:italic>p</jats:italic>-adic curves. Finally, we apply them to define and study RG flows in <jats:italic>p</jats:italic>-adic CFTs, establishing in particular that any IR fixed point is itself a <jats:italic>p</jats:italic>-adic CFT.</jats:p>
title: p-adic CFT is a holographic tensor network
